Aisha: quick sync — noticed tenant `acme-inc` routed to an expensive model variant during yesterday's EU->US failover. policy deltas applied in different orders across regions and produced non-deterministic penalties. anyone else see this?

Ben: yup, saw it. reproduced locally. concurrent policy writes are non-commutative (A then B != B then A). runtime decisions diverge and we get extra hedges. :grimacing:

Carlos: one simple fix is a monotonic `policy_epoch` on compiled bundles. runtime prefers highest epoch and atomically swaps bundle. keeps runtime simple.

Danielle: epoch helps but doesn't help if independent controllers bump concurrently. vector-clock per-namespace could work: controllers increment their axis and runtime merges (sum or lexicographic). resilient to partitions but adds compare complexity.

Ben: vector clocks are heavy. alternative: sequencer service that assigns a strictly increasing apply-ts to deltas (global order). deterministic merges but sequencer is a single availability risk unless we shard/replicate. tail latency tradeoff.

Aisha: tradeoffs summary — sequencer = deterministic & easy to reason about, availability risk; epoch/vector = distributed but complex merge semantics. what about hybrid: local epoch per-region for availability + cross-region reconciliation that reorders deltas into canonical sequence and marks a compatibility window for in-flight requests? while reconcile runs, runtimes set `compat_mode: gradual` so old decisions keep fallback.

Carlos: POC sketch of hybrid bundle:
```json
{"policy_bundle":"pricing-2026-11","policy_epoch":"42","compat_mode":"gradual","compat_window_secs":"60"}
```
runtime: emit header `x-policy-epoch: 42` with decision telemetry. when header mismatches reconciled canonical epoch, runtime yields to `compat_fallback` for existing sessions.

Danielle: ops needs observability before rollout: add trace tag `policy_digest` to decisions, metric `policy_mismatch_rate`, alert if mismatch > 0.5% for 10m. also we need a rollback playbook: how to force all regions back to last-good epoch.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout: policy-svc v1.4.1 -> eu1 (canary 5%), us-west (canary 5%). monitoring `policy_mismatch_rate`.

Aisha: action items — (1) POC hybrid: local epoch + reconciliation job (Carlos + Ben) (2) add `policy_digest` traces & `policy_mismatch_rate` metric (Danielle) (3) draft runbook + RFC for rollout/rollback (Aisha). I'll capture RFC notes and spin up a doc. :thumbsup: 

Ben: I'll bench a tiny sequencer so we can compare latency/availability at 95/99p. will share microbench gist. :eyes: 

Carlos: I'll start reconcile-job sketch and add runtime opt-in flag `compat_mode=gradual` for canary testing.

Danielle: will add alerts and dashboard tiles once trace keys are wired.

Aisha: short RFC by EOD tomorrow and small canary next week. thanks everyone. :rocket:
